card.name: The word interview in news text
card.fires_on: The word "interview" (and sometimes "talk" or "talks") when an article cites or links to a conversation with a named person. It appears in general web news and feature text.

modes.label: Interview as noun
modes.description: The noun "interview" after "an", "special", or a publication name, introducing or sourcing a conversation.
modes.example: he said in an<< interview>> in Barcelona, where he participated in the

modes.label: Talk verbs
modes.description: Verbs like "talk to" or "talks with" that introduce a conversation with a named person.
modes.example: We'll talk<< to>> him about the findings.

card.plain: It lights up on the word interview, where a text points to a conversation with someone.
